topic: set up a mail merge for form letters in Word
core_question: How do I create personalized form letters from a spreadsheet of names and addresses in Word? (secondary: How do I find out if my garden soil is acidic or alkaline?)
answer_summary: On the Mailings tab, choose Start Mail Merge, select the recipient list (e.g., Excel file), insert merge fields, then Finish & Merge.; after the topic shift: Take a soil sample and test it with an inexpensive home soil pH test kit (or send it to a county extension lab) to get a reading.
